title: Do Sakana Fugu or GLM 5.2 actually beat Fable 5?
description:
A new model kills Fable 5 every week. Most of the time it's noise.

Sakana Fugu and GLM 5.2 are the latest.
Fugu routes across frontier models for you.
One API. Multiple models. Zero manual switching.
GLM 5.2 runs locally.
Cheaper than Opus. Reports say better too.
But here's the real thing.
You can't keep testing every new king.
Pick a system that handles the switching.

Like upgrading your phone every month. Exhausting. And you never settle in.

The model race isn't slowing down. Your workflow doesn't have to chase it. Route the rest.

#sakana #glm #fable5 #hermes #aimodels
